hero.title: Pricing
hero.subtitle: Monthly, quarterly, and yearly plans are prepaid once and do not renew. Plan credits arrive each month. Top-up credits stay until you use them.

intro.title: What you get
intro.body: Muvloom is a studio for AI images and video. Describe a picture, keep editing it on an infinite canvas, or finish a set with the agent. Images, video, and chat spend credits at the model price, and the estimate shows before you submit. Failed and cancelled jobs return the hold. Arranging, cropping, and organizing on the canvas does not spend credits.
intro.note: Monthly, quarterly, and yearly plans are a single prepayment. Nothing is charged again when the term ends. Quarterly and yearly credits still arrive once each month, and unused plan credits do not roll over.

rules.title: How credits are spent
rules.meterBody: Images are per picture, video is per second, and chat is per thousand tokens. A submit costs unit price × quantity × multiplier. The image count on a plan spends the whole month at 100 credits per gpt-image-2 image. Other models and video produce fewer images. The estimate is shown before you submit.
rules.bucketBody: Plan credits arrive each month and expire at month end. Top-up credits last. Packs are ¥10, ¥50, and ¥100, at {{rate}} credits per yuan, with or without a plan. Plan credits are spent first.
rules.cycleBody: Monthly, quarterly, and yearly plans are a single payment and do not renew. Quarterly and yearly plans do not drop every month of credits in at once. Each entitlement month still grants that month’s amount.
rules.failureBody: If a job is cancelled or fails before delivery, the hold goes back to the bucket it came from. Retrying that same job does not hold credits again.
rules.inviteBody: When a friend signs up with your invite, each of you receives {{n}} credits in the long-lived balance. Later payments earn the inviter 5% of the amount paid, converted at 100 credits per yuan. That reward sits in a reward balance until you move it. It cannot be withdrawn as cash.

recharge.title: Credit top-up
recharge.subtitle: No plan required. {{rate}} credits per yuan, and they do not expire.

faq.title: Questions
faq.lead: Grants, expiry, spend order, top-ups, and invites.
faq.grantA: The first month arrives when you buy. Quarterly and yearly plans are paid once, but credits still arrive one month at a time.
faq.rolloverA: Plan credits do not. They clear at month end. Top-up credits stay, including after a plan ends.
faq.orderA: This month’s plan credits, then top-up credits.
faq.failureQ: Am I charged if generation fails?
faq.failureA: No. Failure and cancellation return the hold to the original bucket. A retry of that job does not hold credits again.
faq.unitQ: How many credits is one image?
faq.unitA: It depends on the model. gpt-image-2 is listed at 100 credits per image. Video is per second and chat is per token. The estimate before submit is the charge.
faq.estimateQ: Where does “about N images / month” come from?
faq.estimateA: The month’s credits divided by 100, the gpt-image-2 price. That is a ceiling, not a promise. Other image models, video, and chat produce fewer images.
faq.rechargeQ: Can I top up without a plan?
faq.rechargeA: Yes. Packs are ¥10, ¥50, and ¥100, at 400 credits per yuan. They last, and a plan is not required.
faq.renewA: No. Monthly, quarterly, and yearly plans are a single payment. When the term ends, grants stop. The next term is not charged.
faq.inviteQ: Can invite credits be spent or cashed out?
faq.inviteA: Signup rewards can be spent. Rewards from a friend’s payment sit in the reward balance until you move them into top-up credits. They are not cash and cannot be given to someone else.

close.title: Start with one image
close.body: You can top up credits without a plan. After you subscribe, plan credits arrive each month.
